listing.name: Food Commodities
listing.summary: Adding food items to the game for base factions
listing.aiSummary: Adds faction-based food dishes, collectable items, and production buildings to enhance immersion.

description:
Food Commodities

Adding food items to the game for base factions

Download here

Github Repo

What this mod includes

- 5 Faction based food dishes. (For now)
- 1 Collectable item obtainable from exploration/salvage
- A building to produce the food items.
- A simple supply chain

Why this mod exists
Hi, I just found the sector is a bit unlively without much description about daily life and culture.
So I decided to add some commodities to make the gameplay more immersive. (Just a bit!)

AI usage
Coding: Deepseek v4.1 Flash 1017
Artwork: ChatGPT 5.6 Luna

Mod compatibility
No game file is modified, so shouldn't be incompatible with any mods.

This is my first mod, feedbacks are welcomed!
